question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially fill in the diamond-shapes and to balance the given equation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71326f0aded756c56b9954076e3e24eeb3af0aeaff0e1b1274aa458aefa34288.png]
solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10e3be1476caf1bd7e2e109842e7c57ce86da0c54b1b539e233e4e6a7748a44.png] 

Given:

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71326f0aded756c56b9954076e3e24eeb3af0aeaff0e1b1274aa458aefa34288.png] 

(1) **÷, ×, +, =, -**

After Putting the signs:

⇒ __**42 ÷ 7**__ × 5 + 5 = 40 - 5

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**6 × 5 **__+ 5 = 40 - 5

⇒ 30 + 5 = 35</p
